title: Personal Hub (Solara Support)
features:
[1] Esp for Monster Lockers/Trickster rooms/Items/WallDwellers/Entities/broken cables/broken generators/Turrets/Rotten Wall Dwellers

[2] Grab all items (May Lag) (Has A Radius So Get Close)

[3] Delete Eyefestation

[4] Reveal Documents

[5] Inf Yield/Fullbright

[6] Equip Tool/Unequip (better to use with keycard and code breakers cause those are permanent)(You have to have gotten the card before for it to be equipable)

[7] Notifs for all entities and wall dwellers

[8] Instant press prompt for doors

[9] Auto Remove damage parts (Smoke Pipes/Electricity Puddles)

[10] Remove Currency PopUp

If you get the issue were the esp stuff break disable all the toggles and re execute

Discord: https://discord.gg/JsN7UNhh9a for support/bugs
